evals.name: fuzzy-csv-export-ask
evals.prompt:
Use skill: feature-specifier

our support team keeps asking for a way to export invoices as CSV. can you work out what we should actually build here? current pages are public/index.html and public/orders.html, helpers in src/.
evals.expected_output: The agent announces feature-specifier, asks landmine questions (who, where the export lives, columns, cancel, empty list, extras), and does not write application code or a ready-for-developer spec with guessed answers.
assertions: Asks landmine questions or writes Status awaiting-questions
Does not write concept.md or an extra PRD pack
Does not set Status to ready-for-developer with invented answers

evals.name: csv-export-after-answers
evals.prompt:
Use skill: feature-specifier

I want users to export their invoices as CSV from this app. Pages: public/orders.html. Code: src/orders.js.
evals.expected_output: After the scripted answers, agent-engineer-skills/<name>/what-to-build.md exists, uses the template headings, Status is ready-for-developer or draft, and no source was changed.
replies: Answers: 1) Signed-in customers, their own invoices only. 2) A Download CSV button on the existing orders page, not a new page. 3) Columns: date, invoice id, total. 4) Cancel closes without writing a file. 5) If there are no invoices, show 'No invoices to export' on the same page. 6) No PDF, no email, no scheduled export.
assertions: In scope and Out of scope each have an item
No source changes, no extra PRD files

evals.name: refuse-greenfield-mvp
evals.prompt:
Use skill: feature-specifier

I want to build a new app for tracking my houseplants, help me design an MVP from scratch.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses, names mvp-specifier, and does not write a feature spec or scaffold an app.
assertions: Does not write what-to-build.md for a plant-tracker feature
